_reason: CityDex uses NO AI anywhere. The in-app stamp-card generator has been removed entirely: the stamp's name, category and rarity now come from the place (seed data, or a user-typed name + category with rarity 'common' for a new place) and the photo is shown exactly as uploaded. There is no card-generation agent, no Kiro ACP card call, and no kiro-cli subprocess.
